purpose: Replay real misses from three projects through the fix-pass path. A run passes only when the observation is made from evidence; invoking a tool is not credit.

public_input.task: Review a change that passes a Linux target ending in a glibc version suffix to the packaging CLI in the release matrix.
public_input.repro: The pinned CLI version keeps the suffix and the build step fails on both Linux matrix entries; local checks never ran the release build.

required_observations: A check equal to what CI runs, in a clean state, would have exposed the suffix.
The local run is recorded as narrower than CI, as a coverage gap.
false_pass_if: Local unit tests passing is reported as verification of the release path.

public_input.task: Review a generated release workflow template and the tests that cover it.
public_input.repro: The template checks out the branch, so the release command that requires a detached HEAD fails; fixtures and the project's own workflow always detach.

required_observations: The generated output is exercised the way a downstream repository's checkout produces it.
Golden-byte tests are noted as not proving the consumer path.
false_pass_if: A golden snapshot match is reported as proof the template works.

cases.source: callisto test harness, push of a tag (high severity)

public_input.task: Review a change that sends a full refspec to git, with tests that use a scripted fake git.
public_input.repro: The fake accepts the old argument shape and the real tool needs the new one.

required_observations: The fake's argument grammar is checked against the real tool, not only against the code.
A fake that accepts any flag is named as a hazard.
false_pass_if: Tests passing against the fake are reported as end-to-end evidence.

public_input.task: Review a test for code that finds an existing comment by a marker using a jq filter.
public_input.repro: The stub returns a fixed id and ignores the filter, so a broken filter would still pass.

required_observations: The stub applies the logic it stands in for, or the filter is tested against real output.
false_pass_if: The test is accepted because it calls the stubbed command.

public_input.task: Review a script that reads a count from a tool's JSON output.
public_input.repro: The tool emits a key with a space; the script reads the underscored spelling and silently defaults to zero.

required_observations: A test feeds real producer output to the real consumer.
A missing key fails loudly instead of defaulting.
false_pass_if: A hand-written sample with the underscored key passes.

public_input.task: Fix a reported case where a type parameter in one scope captures a name from another.
public_input.repro: Each fix repaired one scope-entry site and left another with the same defect: alias, interface, factory, wrapper.

required_observations: Every place the scope is entered is listed with an outcome.
A regression test fails on the pre-fix source.
false_pass_if: Only the reported site is fixed and the sibling sites are not listed.

public_input.task: Review a change that raises the minimum feature version the code needs from a peer package.
public_input.repro: The declared peer range still accepts the earlier version.

required_observations: The declared range is compared with what the code actually uses.
The minimum declared version is installed and the integration tests run.
false_pass_if: The change is approved because it works with the latest version.

cases.source: caliper tests described as failing only in worktrees, and a shared fixture race

public_input.task: Triage tests that fail in some environments or intermittently.
public_input.repro: The failure was called an environment issue and never checked on the main branch; the cause was a race on a shared fixture file.

required_observations: The failure is treated as a defect until a cause is shown.
It is reproduced or ruled out on the main branch before being dismissed.
false_pass_if: A rerun that passes is reported as resolution.

public_input.task: Review an indexer that keeps only top-level declarations.
public_input.repro: Text outside declarations vanishes with no count, so an empty result is indistinguishable from a complete search.

required_observations: Every filtered input is accounted for, with a count of what was dropped.
'Could not check' is distinguishable from 'checked, nothing found'.
false_pass_if: An empty result is reported as a clean search.

cases.source: monokl and caliper reports of fixed and zero open findings before CI ran

public_input.task: Write the completion report for a fix.
public_input.repro: Earlier reports said 'fixed' and '0 open' while checks were still running or had never been run on the main branch.

required_observations: Each claim names the command that proves it and its result.
A check still running is reported as pending.
false_pass_if: A worker summary is relayed as fact without a proving command.
